review_scope: Re-score saved Q5/Q8/Q9/Q12/Q13/Q14 predictions; verify critical contrasts, source selections and custody of earlier Q1-Q14 review. No fitting, raw-EEG processing or checkpoint inference.

Q8.inferential_role: Exploratory previously examined cohort; sign-test denominator discrepancy is documented, not concealed.

Q13_matched_duration.selection_not_reoptimized: Historical Q5 source-only epoch schedule replayed under matched runtime; not fresh mean-loss reselection.

Q13_source_counts.inference_unit: 9 target participants after averaging four predefined source subsets and three seeds; neither source subsets nor seeds are independent participants. More source people also changes natural optimizer update exposure.

Q14_external.amendment: Three participants 88, 92, 100 had native 128 Hz and were resampled to 160 Hz following metadata-triggered failure after partial external execution; 87 previous participants retained byte-identical prediction evidence. Later portability validation was validation only, not new fitting or inference.

prior_review_reuse.q4_q11_review: Earlier independently recomputed noncritical arms may be reused only where controlling input custody matches; current review separately rescored 38 arms.
prior_review_reuse.q1_q3_and_early_binary: Inventory/earlier review retains binary calibration, expert-clean versus all-trial, extra EOG sensor requirements and single-subject smoke boundaries; not pooled with four-class or external endpoints.

claim_constraints: Nine held-out source participants remain nine independent outcome units; repeated seeds, source subsets and overlapping LOSO source fits cannot be counted as independent replications.
Internal Q5-Q13 development remains exploratory after repeated target exploration.
Matched-runtime fixed20 contrast retains p = 0.125 and historical frozen schedule; confidence interval is unadjusted and does not override the exact test.
No Q12 contrast survives within-family Holm correction; heterogeneity should appear in supplement.
Q14 primary uncertainty spans zero; amended metadata path and validation-only cross-host replay must be disclosed.
Q15 completion permits addition of its separate frozen external results; it does not retrospectively confirm rank-duration selection or all spatial-spectral representations.
